title: Streak Review (2026)
intro: Streak is a Gmail-native CRM built around pipelines, shared email context, mail merge, and lightweight collaboration inside Google Workspace. This review covers Pro/Pro+/Enterprise pricing, AI tools, limitations, and fit.
summary: Streak is a strong fit for Gmail-centric SMB teams. Pro is the CRM entry plan; Pro+ unlocks automations and advanced reports. Scores reflect first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
verdict: Streak is a strong Gmail-native CRM for teams that want pipelines, shared inbox context, and mail tools without leaving Google Workspace. Pro covers core CRM; Pro+ is the practical plan for automations and advanced reports. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research — not hands-on product testing.

criterionAssessments.rationale: For Gmail-centric teams, living inside the inbox is a major usability win — pipelines and email history stay in one place without a separate CRM tab habit.
Shared pipelines, filters, custom/magic fields, and deal timelines are first-party documented strengths for Gmail CRM workflows.
Automations are a clear Pro+ story; base Pro is more collaboration/CRM than automation suite.
Gmail-native email sharing, tracking, snippets, and mail merge are Streak’s standout capability — including free forever email power tools.
Advanced reports are documented on Pro+; adequate for SMB pipeline reporting, not a BI suite.
Custom fields, magic fields, formulas, and multiple pipeline processes support varied Gmail-team workflows.
Gmail/Google Drive depth is excellent, but broader marketplace breadth is secondary and plan-gated versus dedicated CRM marketplaces.
For Google Workspace teams, admin burden is comparatively light; Enterprise adds roles/validation when needed.
Works well for SMB Gmail teams; Enterprise helps larger orgs, but Gmail coupling and AI credit metering remain constraints.
Free email tools plus Pro at $49 annual is competitive for Gmail teams; Pro+ ($69) is the practical tier when automations/reports matter.

faq.question: How much does Streak cost?
faq.answer: Streak publishes Pro at $49/user/mo annually ($59 monthly), Pro+ at $69/$89, and Enterprise at $129/$159. Free email power tools are available forever, and paid plans include a 14-day trial.

faq.question: Is Streak free?
faq.answer: Streak offers free forever email tools (tracking, snippets, limited mail merge). Full CRM pipelines require a paid Pro plan or higher.

faq.question: Does Streak work outside Gmail?
faq.answer: Streak is built as a Gmail-native CRM. Teams standardized on Outlook/Microsoft 365 should expect a weaker fit.

faq.question: Is this a hands-on SoftwareGlimpse lab review?
faq.answer: No. This review is approved based on first-party Streak pricing and product research, not hands-on testing.

sections.heading: What Streak is
sections.body: Streak is a CRM designed to live in Gmail. Pipelines, contacts, and email history stay beside the inbox for Google Workspace teams.

sections.heading: Pricing and plans
sections.body: Free email tools sit below paid Pro, Pro+, and Enterprise CRM plans. Annual USD list pricing starts at $49/user/mo for Pro; Pro+ is the automation/reporting tier.

sections.heading: Core CRM capabilities
sections.body: Documented strengths include shared pipelines, magic fields, mail merge/tracking, mobile apps, and Pro+ automations plus AI credits.

sections.heading: Who it’s for
sections.body: Best for Gmail-centric SMB teams. Less ideal for Outlook-first orgs or marketing-automation buyers.
